Home / Our Accomodations / Villa Los Monos
This 65m2 (700 sq feet) large house can accommodate up to 6 guests with the greatest comfort.
Isolated by vegetation, it guarantees quiet, relax and privacy.
Both bedrooms are furnished with an orthopaedic mattress, a large wooden wardrobe shelving unit, lockbox and ceiling fan.
There are fly screens on the windows.
In one bedroom, you will find a Queen size bed. In the other bedroom, you will find two individuals beds that can be joined in one King size bed.
Each of the 2 bathrooms has a hot water shower.
In both living rooms, you will find a sofa bed and a ceiling fan.
The kitchen is fully out fitted with a full size refrigerator, a 2 burner stove, coffee maker, blender, toaster, bottled water unit…
The large partly covered terrace offers table, wooden Adirondack chairs as well as a bar corner with 3 stools open to the kitchen.
